newsitem.title: USA: Wave launches Internet publishing service.
newsitem.headline: Wave launches Internet publishing service.

text.p: Wave Systems Corp said Monday it has introduced WINPublish, calling it the first commercial component of Wave Interactive Network's Internet strategy.
It described WINPublish as a commerce and publishing environment allowing Internet users to publish and sell "anything at any price" on their web page.

Wave's goal is to provide a publishing solution that enables everyone with an idea, or who controls copyrights to intellectual property, to publish their content on the World Wide Web and get paid when that content is accessed.
Wave said its micro-publishing service is comprised of two components: WINPublish and WINPurchase.
The WINPublish component provides tools to upload creative content in an encrypted and ready for purchase format with the payment of an annual $25 registration fee.

The WINPurchase component will be launched October 8th. It is the buying side of the service. Those seeking to buy the available content will register on-line by opening a secure cash account, via credit card, stored on a Wave server. Wave's metering technology will record transactions and deduct purchase amounts from the user accounts.
